title: 20 Years of God's Faithfulness
subtitle: 20th Anniversary Celebration
captions: Sample: Twenty years ago, a small group started something.
Sample: This is how God has been faithful, year by year.
Sample: It begins, and ends, with His mercy.

verse.text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

closing.heading: To God be the glory
closing.text: Thank you for twenty years of worship, prayer and service together. Here's to the next twenty.
captions: Sample: Twenty years, and every one of them a gift.
Sample: None of it was ours alone.
Sample: And He is not finished yet.

verse.text: Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.

milestones.title: The first service
milestones.text: Sample: a small group gathers for the first time to worship and pray together.
captions: Sample: It's 2006.
Sample: A handful of people hold their very first service.
Sample: Nobody there knew what it would grow into.

milestones.title: A place to call home
milestones.text: Sample: the church moves into its first regular meeting place.
captions: Sample: Two years later.
Sample: The church finally has somewhere to call home.
Sample: A regular place to meet, every week.

milestones.title: Ministries take root
milestones.text: Sample: the music, prayer and children's ministries are formed.
captions: Sample: By 2011, the church is growing.
Sample: And the ministries start to take root.
Sample: Music, prayer, and the children's ministry.

milestones.title: Sending out
milestones.text: Sample: the first outreach and mission trip.
captions: Sample: 2014.
Sample: For the first time, the church sends people out.
Sample: The first outreach and mission trip.

milestones.title: Growing together
milestones.text: Sample: membership grows and new cell groups begin.
captions: Sample: Three years on.
Sample: The church keeps growing, together.
Sample: New cell groups begin across the city.

milestones.title: Faithful through the storm
milestones.text: Sample: the church keeps meeting online through the pandemic.
captions: Sample: Then came 2020.
Sample: The doors closed, but the church kept going.
Sample: Every service moved online, and nobody was left behind.

milestones.title: A new season
milestones.text: Sample: a new milestone for the church family.
captions: Sample: 2023.
Sample: A new season begins.
Sample: The church family gathers again, stronger.

milestones.title: Twenty years
milestones.text: Sample: the church celebrates twenty years of God's faithfulness.
captions: Sample: Which brings us to today.
Sample: Twenty years.
Sample: Twenty years of God's faithfulness.
